releases.author: github-actions[bot]
releases.description:
### Features
- Show status bar indicator while transcribing and enriching
- Add separate Whisper API key setting with masked input

### Fixes
- Derive recording file extension from actual MIME type instead of hardcoding .webm
- Support more audio formats (ogg, mp4/m4a, mp3, wav, flac)
- Resolve multiple robustness issues around error handling

### Improvements
- Decouple record, transcribe, and enrich into independent commands
- Add [GPL-3.0 license](https://github.com/derogab/ai-notes/blob/master/LICENSE)
- Add README with full documentation and privacy disclosure
- Prepare plugin for [Obsidian community plugin submission](https://docs.obsidian.md/Plugins/Releasing/Submission+requirements+for+plugins)

---

**Full Changelog**: https://github.com/derogab/ai-notes/compare/0.0.1...0.1.0
